name: hunyuan3d-workbench
description: Tripo3D 风格的混元生3D 工作台（Node.js + TypeScript + Vue 3）

scripts.build: npm run build -w @h3d/web && npm run build -w @h3d/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @h3d/api && npm run typecheck -w @h3d/web
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks || echo "[prepare] 跳过 git hooks 配置"
